description: Top-down sprites for the match viewer: operators (player figures, rotated by the renderer to face their aim) and map props laid over their exact tile footprint. The renderer adds shadows and lighting.
style: Game asset sprite, perfectly orthographic top-down view looking straight down from above, isolated object centred on a fully transparent background, photorealistic but clean and readable at small sizes, flat even lighting with no cast shadow on the ground, no ground plane, no perspective. For a premium tactical shooter esports game's overhead broadcast view. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
